findings.span: VFX 프리비즈: 재촬영 전 임시로 샷을 확장해 프리비주얼라이징.
findings.suggestion: VFX 임시 작업: 재촬영을 확정하기 전에 프리비즈 단계에서 설정 샷을 확장.
findings.reason: Redundant repetition of the same concept (프리비즈 / 프리비주얼라이징) and 'establishing shots' is reduced to just '샷'; the sentence also ends with an unnatural noun form.
'내보내기 합니다' is ungrammatical noun+verb mixing; a native speaker would write '내보냅니다'.
Inconsistent terminology for 'trim': '트림' here vs '트리밍' throughout extendedDescription, howToUse, and faqItems.
The workflow name is translated in the title field ('비디오 확장') but left in English here, making the page inconsistent.
'extended video' is rendered as '연장' here while the title, description and metaDescription use '확장' for the same concept.
Glossary requires 'Object' → '오브젝트'; the metaDescription and extendedDescription use '오브젝트 제거', so the title/description line is inconsistent with the rest of the page.
'object' is rendered as '오브젝트' elsewhere on the page (and required by glossary); mixing '객체' and '오브젝트' is inconsistent.
'enthusiasts' is flattened to the generic '사용자', losing the intended meaning of hobbyists/enthusiasts.

'talent casting' is rendered as 인재 캐스팅 here but as 탤런트 캐스팅 in the title (and 탤런트 in the FAQ); 인재 means 'skilled personnel/HR talent', which is wrong in an advertising-casting context and inconsistent across the page.
'reference' must use the required UI translation 참조; the page also uses 참조 in the extended description and 참고 이미지 in the FAQ, so the term is inconsistent.
'preview' must be translated as 미리보기 per the required term list; 미리보기 is used elsewhere on the page.
'Filenames' must use the required translation 파일 이름.
'STEP 2' is kept in English as a group label everywhere else (extendedDescription, howToUse) but translated as 2단계 here, breaking consistency with the on-canvas label.

findings.span: 반드시 인물 사진을 첫 번째 참고 이미지로 불러오세요
findings.suggestion: 인물 사진을 기본 참조로 먼저 불러오세요
findings.reason: Adds the emphatic '반드시' (must/absolutely), which is not in the English, and conflates 'primary reference' with 'first image'.
English says 'if available', the translation says 'if needed', shifting the condition.

The title is transliterated while the extendedDescription keeps the English name 'Hairstyle Changer' and the description renders it as '헤어스타일 변경 워크플로'; the workflow name is handled three different ways across the page.
Required product-UI term: color → 색상. The description already uses '헤어 색상', so '컬러' is also inconsistent within the page.
'selfie' is rendered as '셀피' in the description and extendedDescription but as '셀카' here and in the FAQ; inconsistent terminology within one entry.

findings.reason: English says 'Wig and color try-ons for e-commerce'; the notion of 'try-ons' (virtual try-on) is dropped, leaving an ambiguous noun phrase.
